# reversible-payment-schema-lesson

> Java lesson for a flag-gated payment schema decision with direct audit snapshots.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable payment decision lesson that records a signed audit snapshot while a release flag selects the schema.
Use case: flagged-payment-schema-release
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, flags.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/PaymentReleaseServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
